description: We are building AstroCadet, an interactive web-based Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer powered by real NASA ISS telemetry and life-support data. Players master zero-gravity physics across three hands-on missions: 3D ISS docking, spacewalk oxygen/thermal management, and live orbital tracking. Led by an Aeronautical Engineering student, we are seeking Web/3D devs, UI/UX game designers, and storytellers to turn real spaceflight engineering into an accessible STEM game!
